description: Crack password hashes offline with hashcat (GPU) and John the Ripper (CPU) — hash-mode selection, attack modes (straight/mask/combinator/rules), the -m type table, *2john extractors, and potfile discipline. Load when loot includes hashes: NTLM/NetNTLMv2 dumps, Kerberos TGS (kerberoast), JWT secrets, /etc/shadow, zip/rar/ssh key passwords. Signals: hashcat -m, rockyou, best64.rule, $6$ hashes, unshadow, john --show, mask ?a?a?a.
